plan.summary: Ensure secure handling of YAML files to prevent code execution vulnerabilities.
threats: Code execution via malicious YAML content
Denial of Service via large or complex YAML structures
algorithm: Validate the input filename against allowed paths and extensions.
Open the file in a safe context.
Load the YAML content using a secure loading method.
error_handling: FileNotFoundError -> log error and raise exception; yaml.YAMLError -> return error response to user
acceptance_criteria: Filename must pass validation against allowed extensions and paths.
YAML loading must succeed without exceptions.
Content must not include executable code.

plan.summary: Avoid unsafe deserialization from user input to prevent remote code execution.
algorithm: Validate input source and schema.
Use base64 decoding with safe methods.
Implement strict deserialization controls.
Avoid using pickle; consider JSON or other safer formats.

error_handling.Exception: log error and return 500 Internal Server Error

acceptance_criteria: No untrusted input can be passed to deserialization functions.
Responses must not include internal state information.

plan_raw:
{
  "cwe": "CWE-601",
  "summary": "Validate URLs for redirection to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities.",
  "threats": [
    "Open Redirect Attacks",
    "Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)",
    "Phishing Attempts"
  ],
  "policy": {
    "allowed_schemes": ["http", "https"],
    "allowed_hosts": ["example.com", "sub.example.com"],
    "disallowed_paths": ["/admin", "/private"]
  },
  "algorithm": [
    "Extract the 'target' URL from the request parameters.",
    "Validate the URL format using a regex.",
    "Check if the scheme is allowed.",
    "Check if the host matches the allowed hosts.",
    "Redirect to the valid URL if all checks pass, otherwise return an error response."
  ],
  "secure_apis": [
    "urllib.parse.urlparse",
    "re.match"
  ],
  "error_handling": [
    "KeyError -> return 'Missing target parameter'",
    "ValueError -> return 'Invalid target URL'",
    "RedirectException -> return 'Unauthorized redirection attempt'"
  ],
  "acceptance_criteria": [
    "Only URLs matching the policy are redirected.",
    "Invalid URLs return an appropriate error response.",
    "Redirect behavior is logged for audit purposes."
  ]
}
